lines.pinyin: shān míng shuǐ jìng yè lái shuāng
lines.cn: 山色明朗水波明净，夜里悄然凝结了白霜
lines.en: Hills clear and waters pristine as nighttime frost descends,

lines.pinyin: shù shù shēn hóng chū qiǎn huáng
lines.cn: 几树霜叶色彩斑斓，浓艳的深红中透着淡雅的浅黄
lines.en: Vibrant trees reveal deep crimson amidst hues of pale gold.

lines.pinyin: shì shàng gāo lóu qīng rù gǔ
lines.cn: 试着登上高楼凭栏远眺，秋天的清爽爽朗直透骨髓
lines.en: Climbing high towers, the crisp autumn air chills clear to the bone,

lines.pinyin: qǐ rú chūn sè sǒu rén kuáng
lines.cn: 哪像浮华喧闹的春色那样，教人心神轻狂躁动
lines.en: Far unlike the dizzying spring colors that urge men to foolish frenzy.
